title: xDrip does not recognise new G7 sensor, despite correct code, and it working on Tandem T-slim pump
body:
### Discussed in https://github.com/NightscoutFoundation/xDrip/discussions/3687
Originally posted by **shrewsdog** September 28, 2024 Issue is xDrip not recognising a new sensor (which is working on Tandem T-Slim pump). System Status has correct TX ID for new sensor, but transmitter days and battery voltages are clearly for the old transmitter as days are 10, and voltage a 280 and b 176. Data source is shown as G6/G7/1/1+ Transmitter, and xDrip version is dfcbe80-20240917. Phone is Motorola Moto g(6) Play. Catalogue of errors by me. Had G7 on day nine. Had been erratic, so inserted new one early. Then realised I needed to stop the first one. Used stop sensor which stopped both (at this point I believed I had not paired sensor 2). Then removed the 2 sensor TXs from bluetooth list on my phone and rebooted. Inserted sensor 3, paired it with pump which is receiving data correctly. New TX ID on phone is correct, but the status page is showing the old day nine sensor and battery data, and the main page records sensor error and 'Ends 7.48' tomorrow. I opted to put an incorrect TX ID in Xdrip, allowed it to try to connect, and when it failed reinputted the correct TX, but no change. Both the expiring sensor and its replacement have been sat in microwave for hours. Applicator code for new sensor is correct. It is as though the tx data for the first sensor is 'locked' on the phone.
